sliceTask: M002/S03/T03 — 401-mid-browse proof: single silent refresh and load
environment: live, no mocks, no simulated tokens; Vite dev server at http://127.0.0.1:3000; real Spotify Web API + accounts.spotify.com token endpoint
method: Genuinely expired access token (issued 21:54 UTC window, expiresAt 2026-11-08T22:47:09.588Z — expired >8 min before the test) restored into the live SPA session; in-page fetch tap (transparent observer wrapping window.fetch, all requests still hit the real network) recorded method/URL/status; SPA route change (pushState + popstate, no page reload — true mid-browse) opened /playlist/4Jav8XB3XHsxfZHx5lBJeB.
tokenExpiryReal: The access token from the T02 human-logged-in session was allowed to expire naturally (3600s Spotify validity). No expiry was faked; no responses were mocked.

assertions.real401: Two concurrent GET /v1/playlists/4Jav8XB3XHsxfZHx5lBJeB/items?limit=100 both returned 401 from real Spotify (React StrictMode dev double-invoke produced two parallel fetches — an even stronger concurrency test for the single-flight contract).
assertions.exactlyOneRefresh: Exactly ONE POST to https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token (200) despite two concurrent 401 callers — single-flight refresh (src/api/authedFetch.ts) merged them into one in-flight promise.
assertions.retrySucceeded: Retried GET /items?limit=100 returned 200 with the fresh token; cursor page 2 (offset=100) also 200.
assertions.tracksRendered: 142 track rows rendered (matches T02's FinLT track count); role=status loading cleared; NO role=alert error state.
assertions.consoleContract: Console showed exactly one '[auth:refresh] access token rejected (401) — attempting silent refresh' and one '[auth:refresh] silent refresh succeeded' (D003 logging contract).
assertions.tokenPersisted: localStorage harlequin.spotify.tokens updated by the app's refreshAccessToken/saveTokens: newExpiresAt 2026-11-08T23:55:50.552Z (= refresh time + 3600s, real expires_in), refresh token unchanged (Spotify did not rotate), scope intact.
assertions.backToGrid: SPA Back to '/' rendered the authed Home grid with the refreshed token: 'Signed in' header, FinLT card present, 47 buttons, /v1/me 200, two /v1/me/playlists pages 200, no alert, no failure.
assertions.noGhostSession: No logout performed; no PKCE sessionStorage keys present; teardown path (L001, api/auth.ts logout) untouched — zero code changes in this slice.

deviations: browser_get_network_logs does not capture cross-origin fetches in this environment (T02's network.json is likewise empty), so an in-page transparent fetch tap supplied method/URL/status evidence; the tap alters no responses — every request still hit the real Spotify API. The T02 live session had closed before the token expired, so the expired-token state was restored into a fresh SPA session and the playlist was opened via SPA route change (mid-browse) rather than a grid click; the grid itself gates on hasUsableAccessToken and correctly shows Connect after expiry — the R009 contract being proven is the API-layer 401 path, which this exercises end-to-end.
